$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNB (AIP France, chart dated 2026-04-16): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Mende - Brenoux

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: AFIS : ETE / SUM : VEN-DIM/ FRI-SUN : 0800-1000 ; 1130-1630, HIV / WIN : SAM-DIM/ SAT-SUN : 1200-1530 (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

notes: AD prohibited to ULM class 1 and 5 except authorization by AD operator.
ULM strip reserved for based ULM and for aircraft authorised by AD operator.
ULM strip prohibited when gliders and tow aircraft are on the apron at the end of RWY 30.
ULM strip prohibited in presence of hot-air balloon.
Simultaneous use of ULM strip and RWY 12/30 prohibited.
RWY 30 strong down drafts when northerly winds.
ULM RWY 12 landing: beware of the vegetation in the east of the ULM strip near the ULM RWY 12 THR.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Avoid overflight of Truc de Balduc, out of respect for birds of prey.
From July to August, a public safety helicopter is based on AD: the parking stands on the right of the refuelling station and on the signal area side are reserved for public safety.
Heavy turbulence generated in the vicinity.
AEM NR 9643: see AIP ENR 5.5 Towing glider activity RWY 12/30.
